summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, _make_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open with overloads and Progress.wrap_file), tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the __main__ block), docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage), CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet for PR 1759). The diff is additive only. Not verified: tests, mypy, and black were not run. Risks: module-level wrap_file carries a return-value type-ignore beyond the spec's list (mypy strict may need it), suppression codes are mapped to mypy names, and a failed file open leaves its task created because the spec orders task creation before the open. Next step: run pytest tests/test_progress.py, mypy -p rich, and black --check.
